scope: Machine sided item automation and standard phase-fluid containers
runtime_owner: root; this subagent has not run Gradle or runtime tests

capability_coverage.metal_former: Existing sided item handlers retained; stale instances now reject after removal.
capability_coverage.imag_fusor: Existing top material/fluid, side energy, bottom output handlers retained; fluid input accepts standard phase containers; stale instances reject after removal.
capability_coverage.phase_generator: Top fluid container input; horizontal energy item input; bottom returned container and fully charged energy item extraction; null side combines these rules.
capability_coverage.solar_generator: Top/horizontal energy item input; bottom fully charged item extraction; original stack limit and energy conversion retained.
capability_coverage.wind_generator_base: Same charging rules as solar, with an upper proxy referencing the live base; removed proxy/base or unloaded base stops the old handler.
capability_coverage.owner_restricted_machines: Node, matrix, interferer, turbine fan and developer inventories receive no new identity-free automation access.

container_transaction.legacy: Matter Unit consumes one item for exactly 1000 mB and returns one empty unit.
container_transaction.standard: NeoForge tryEmptyContainer previews against the destination without changing input or tank; output availability is checked before execute; getResult supplies the actual replacement/remaining container.
container_transaction.output_merge: Same item and identical components only, respecting stack capacity; blocked output leaves input and fluid untouched.
container_transaction.partial: A partially drained container returns to the output slot with its remaining fluid and components.
container_transaction.consumable: An empty returned stack consumes the input without requiring an empty-container output slot.
container_transaction.unchanged: Existing tank sizes, production rates, save keys, registry IDs and 4 FE = 1 IF are preserved.

test_fixture_boundary: AutomationFluidFixtures is auditTest-only. It registers a probe data component and native NeoForge partial/consumable/swapping fluid handlers on three otherwise unused vanilla items, and is excluded from the delivery JAR. No third-party mod runtime result is implied.
static_review: Compared production edits to released commit 4993aed with EOL differences ignored; git diff --check passed for the edited production paths. Actual compilation and GameTest acceptance remain pending root execution.
